items.q: How many cups of coffee are bought in London on a typical weekday?
c: About 9 million people live in London
Say 1 in 3 buys at least one coffee out on a weekday: 3 million
Average about 1.3 cups each: about 4 million
Add some commuters and visitors: call it 4 to 5 million
items.n: Population × share who do it × how often is the most useful chain in business sizing.
